summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing an update to its Share Purchase Plan (SPP) announced on 17 June 2026. The sole change is an accelerated closing date: the SPP will now close at 5:00pm AEST on 17 July 2026, rather than the originally scheduled 14 August 2026. No new pricing, share amounts, or economic terms are disclosed; the filing merely adjusts the timetable following waivers from ASX Listing Rules 7.1 and 10.11 obtained on 6 July 2026. This is a routine timetable update for an existing capital-raising plan, not a special situation, and does not represent an event-driven corporate action.
